mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate above 9.5% reflects weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, signaling weakening economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1pp

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling weakening economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 600.0 (thousands of units) indicates strengthening residential construction, which precedes broader economic expansion and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.5%), a monthly payroll increase above 100k signals improving labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate hiring for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5% and PAYEMS increases > 100k

mechanism_narrative: A sudden federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points over one month signals unexpected monetary tightening, causing immediate equity market sell-off and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.2pp
